title: Published engineering capability guidance
description: Expose portable engineering capabilities and guide their bounded invocation, specialist procedure, handoff, and optional governed recording without replacing project authority or specialist contracts.
responsibilities: Identify task fit, prepare applicable project context, and resolve resources needed by the selected invocation.
Guide the selected specialist activity and determine an applicable handoff using its governing inputs, limits, and assessments.
Prepare explicit recording operations and interpret actual command outcomes when governed recording is selected.
owned_state: Published capability descriptions and procedural composition at the common invocation boundary; specialist methods, project state, authority, and evidence retain their own owners.

includes: Capability selection, portable invocation, conditional resource/evidence access, bounded specialist guidance, handoffs, and governed command use.
excludes: A hosted agent runtime, silently expanded invocation scope, package qualification from one successful invocation, mechanical record publication, or universal adoption of REM into installed skills.

design_limits: MOD-008 remains accountable for REM model-authoring guidance; MOD-006/007/009 retain shared authority, assurance, and learning meanings. This common published capability responsibility does not duplicate their detailed contracts.
Specialist child Designs retain their complete clauses. Additional specialist Interfaces, ARs, and exact skill-to-Function realization mappings are deferred.
The current published capability output scope is not expanded by the new REM drafts. Actor-facing instruction packages remain distinct from agent execution and any public API.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.
